cases.description: A query left RESERVED when the gateway process exits is charged its full reservation and marked INDETERMINATE on restart.
A query that settled before the crash keeps its durable charge; recovery does not double-charge terminal records.
The hash-chain audit log has no gap after recovery appends its INDETERMINATE event.
An orphaned query whose reservation equals the task limit is charged to the hard limit on recovery without breaking the ledger invariant.
